name: lnd-artifacts
description: Per-project AI artifact transport: keeps .claude/, openspec/, CLAUDE.md and friends in a private artifact repo cloned into the host project's git common dir, symlinked into the project root and never committed to the customer remote.

interface.shortDescription: Private per-project artifact repo, symlinked in, never committed to the customer repo
interface.longDescription: Keeps a project's AI artifacts (.claude/, openspec/, CLAUDE.md, …) in a private artifact repository cloned into the host project's git common dir (.git/lundegaard). Every first-level entry of the store is symlinked into the project root and ignored through a managed block in <git-common-dir>/info/exclude, so the customer repository never sees them. Verbs: init, heal, adopt, sync, status, detach — POSIX shell and git only. The engine never commits or pushes the host repository, and syncing the artifact repo is always an explicit decision.
defaultPrompt: Set up artifact management for this project
